description: User-provided physical distances, one frozen camera frame and one manually selected tissue-box point at each position. No camera imagery saved.

calibration.note: Restored from the prior live session rounded to three decimal places; the calibration point is not an independent test.

samples.note: user confirmed distance; manually selected point

limitations: One frame per distance, no repeated-trial uncertainty estimate.

two_point_candidate.note: Applied manually to the mixed-precision live mode after a single held-out frame; same object and camera, limited evidence. Calibration resets on page reload or precision change.

live_after_application.note: different later frame and object box statistic; not the same pixel or an independent multi-scene validation
